description: List every discovered library, including ones whose schema is unsupported. Re-scans on every call, so a drive plugged in after this server started is visible without a restart (the engine://libraries resource is a start-time snapshot). A library seen before but not readable right now (e.g. Engine DJ is writing to it) stays listed with status: "unreadable" and error set, instead of disappearing. Pass a listed uuid or path as the `library` argument of any other tool to act on that library; without it they use the supported library holding the most tracks.
name: list_libraries
title: List Engine DJ libraries
